function automatic int calc_ds_len(input logic [ADDR_W-1:0] addr, input logic [7:0] len, input logic [2:0] size);
  int beat_bytes = 1 << size;
  int dsize = (size > 1) ? 1 : size;
  int dbeat_bytes = 1 << dsize;
  int total_bytes = (len + 1) * beat_bytes - (addr - (addr & ~(beat_bytes-1)));
  int first = addr;
  int last = addr + total_bytes - 1;
  int aligned_first = first & ~(dbeat_bytes-1);
  int aligned_last = last & ~(dbeat_bytes-1);
  int ds_len = (aligned_last - aligned_first) / dbeat_bytes;
  return ds_len;
endfunction

    .s_rresp(s_rresp),
    .s_rlast(s_rlast),
    .s_rvalid(s_rvalid),
    .s_rready(s_rready),
    .m_awid(m_awid),
    .m_awaddr(m_awaddr),
    .m_awlen(m_awlen),
    .m_awsize(m_awsize),
    .m_awburst(m_awburst),
    .m_awvalid(m_awvalid),
    .m_awready(m_awready),
    .m_wdata(m_wdata),
    .m_wstrb(m_wstrb),
    .m_wlast(m_wlast),
    .m_wvalid(m_wvalid),
    .m_wready(m_wready),
    .m_bid(m_bid),
    .m_bresp(m_bresp),
    .m_bvalid(m_bvalid),
    .m_bready(m_bready),
    .m_arid(m_arid),
    .m_araddr(m_araddr),
    .m_arlen(m_arlen),
    .m_arsize(m_arsize),
    .m_arburst(m_arburst),
    .m_arvalid(m_arvalid),
    .m_arready(m_arready),
    .m_rid(m_rid),
    .m_rdata(m_rdata),
    .m_rresp(m_rresp),
    .m_rlast(m_rlast),
    .m_rvalid(m_rvalid),
    .m_rready(m_rready)
  );

  // Queues for downstream monitoring
  logic [ID_W-1:0] aw_id_q[$];
  logic [ADDR_W-1:0] aw_addr_q[$];
  logic [7:0] aw_len_q[$];
  logic [2:0] aw_size_q[$];
  logic [1:0] aw_burst_q[$];

  logic [SLV_DATA_W-1:0] w_data_q[$];
  logic [SLV_DATA_W/8-1:0] w_strb_q[$];
  logic w_last_q[$];

  logic [ID_W-1:0] ar_id_q[$];
  logic [ADDR_W-1:0] ar_addr_q[$];
  logic [7:0] ar_len_q[$];
  logic [2:0] ar_size_q[$];
  logic [1:0] ar_burst_q[$];

  // Error counter
  int errors = 0;

  task automatic check(input bit cond, input string msg);
    if (!cond) begin
      errors++;
      $display("FAIL: %s", msg);
    end
  endtask

  // Clear queues
  task automatic clear_queues();
    aw_id_q.delete();
    aw_addr_q.delete();
    aw_len_q.delete();
    aw_size_q.delete();
    aw_burst_q.delete();
    w_data_q.delete();
    w_strb_q.delete();
    w_last_q.delete();
    ar_id_q.delete();
    ar_addr_q.delete();
    ar_len_q.delete();
    ar_size_q.delete();
    ar_burst_q.delete();
  endtask

  // Reset task
  task automatic do_reset(input int cycles = 4);
    @(negedge clk);
    rst_n = 0;
    repeat (cycles) @(posedge clk);
    @(negedge clk);
    rst_n = 1;
  endtask

  // Upstream master tasks
  task automatic send_aw(input logic [ID_W-1:0] id,
                         input logic [ADDR_W-1:0] addr,
                         input logic [7:0] len,
                         input logic [2:0] size,
                         input logic [1:0] burst,
                         input int timeout,
                         output bit accepted);
    int waited = 0;
    accepted = 0;
    @(negedge clk);
    s_awid = id;
    s_awaddr = addr;
    s_awlen = len;
    s_awsize = size;
    s_awburst = burst;
    s_awvalid = 1;
    while (waited < timeout) begin
      @(posedge clk);
      if (s_awready) begin
        accepted = 1;
        break;
      end
      waited++;
    end
    @(negedge clk);
    s_awvalid = 0;
  endtask

  task automatic send_ar(input logic [ID_W-1:0] id,
                         input logic [ADDR_W-1:0] addr,
                         input logic [7:0] len,
                         input logic [2:0] size,
                         input logic [1:0] burst,
                         input int timeout,
                         output bit accepted);
    int waited = 0;
    accepted = 0;
    @(negedge clk);
    s_arid = id;
    s_araddr = addr;
    s_arlen = len;
    s_arsize = size;
    s_arburst = burst;
    s_arvalid = 1;
    while (waited < timeout) begin
      @(posedge clk);
      if (s_arready) begin
        accepted = 1;
        break;
      end
      waited++;
    end
    @(negedge clk);
    s_arvalid = 0;
  endtask

  task automatic send_w(input logic [SLV_DATA_W-1:0] data,
                        input logic [SLV_DATA_W/8-1:0] strb,
                        input logic last,
                        input int timeout,
                        output bit accepted);
    int waited = 0;
    accepted = 0;
    @(negedge clk);
    s_wdata = data;
    s_wstrb = strb;
    s_wlast = last;
    s_wvalid = 1;
    while (waited < timeout) begin
      @(posedge clk);
      if (s_wready) begin
        accepted = 1;
        break;
      end
      waited++;
    end
    @(negedge clk);
    s_wvalid = 0;
  endtask

  task automatic recv_b(output logic [ID_W-1:0] id,
                        output logic [1:0] resp,
                        input int timeout,
                        output bit received);
    int waited = 0;
    received = 0;
    while (waited < timeout) begin
      @(posedge clk);
      if (s_bvalid) begin
        id = s_bid;
        resp = s_bresp;
        received = 1;
        break;
      end
      waited++;
    end
  endtask

  task automatic recv_r(output logic [ID_W-1:0] id,
                        output logic [SLV_DATA_W-1:0] data,
                        output logic [1:0] resp,
                        output logic last,
                        input int timeout,
                        output bit received);
    int waited = 0;
    received = 0;
    while (waited < timeout) begin
      @(posedge clk);
      if (s_rvalid) begin
        id = s_rid;
        data = s_rdata;
        resp = s_rresp;
        last = s_rlast;
        received = 1;
        break;
      end
      waited++;
    end
  endtask

  // Downstream slave tasks
  task automatic send_b(input logic [ID_W-1:0] id, input logic [1:0] resp);
    @(negedge clk);
    m_bid = id;
    m_bresp = resp;
    m_bvalid = 1;
    @(posedge clk);
    while (!m_bready) @(posedge clk);
    @(negedge clk);
    m_bvalid = 0;
  endtask

  task automatic send_r_beat(input logic [ID_W-1:0] id,
                             input logic [MST_DATA_W-1:0] data,
                             input logic [1:0] resp,
                             input logic last);
    @(negedge clk);
    m_rid = id;
    m_rdata = data;
    m_rresp = resp;
    m_rlast = last;
    m_rvalid = 1;
    @(posedge clk);
    while (!m_rready) @(posedge clk);
    @(negedge clk);
    m_rvalid = 0;
  endtask

  // Get downstream transactions
  task automatic get_aw(output bit found,
                        output logic [ID_W-1:0] id,
                        output logic [ADDR_W-1:0] addr,
                        output logic [7:0] len,
                        output logic [2:0] size,
                        output logic [1:0] burst,
                        input int timeout);
    int waited = 0;
    found = 0;
    while (waited < timeout) begin
      if (aw_id_q.size() > 0) begin
        id = aw_id_q.pop_front();
        addr = aw_addr_q.pop_front();
        len = aw_len_q.pop_front();
        size = aw_size_q.pop_front();
        burst = aw_burst_q.pop_front();
        found = 1;
        break;
      end
      @(posedge clk);
      waited++;
    end
  endtask

  task automatic get_w(output bit found,
                       output logic [SLV_DATA_W-1:0] data,
                       output logic [SLV_DATA_W/8-1:0] strb,
                       output logic last,
                       input int timeout);
    int waited = 0;
    found = 0;
    while (waited < timeout) begin
      if (w_data_q.size() > 0) begin
        data = w_data_q.pop_front();
        strb = w_strb_q.pop_front();
        last = w_last_q.pop_front();
        found = 1;
        break;
      end
      @(posedge clk);
      waited++;
    end
  endtask

  task automatic get_ar(output bit found,
                        output logic [ID_W-1:0] id,
                        output logic [ADDR_W-1:0] addr,
                        output logic [7:0] len,
                        output logic [2:0] size,
                        output logic [1:0] burst,
                        input int timeout);
    int waited = 0;
    found = 0;
    while (waited < timeout) begin
      if (ar_id_q.size() > 0) begin
        id = ar_id_q.pop_front();
        addr = ar_addr_q.pop_front();
        len = ar_len_q.pop_front();
        size = ar_size_q.pop_front();
        burst = ar_burst_q.pop_front();
        found = 1;
        break;
      end
      @(posedge clk);
      waited++;
    end
  endtask

  // Monitor downstream handshakes
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst_n) begin
      if (m_awvalid && m_awready) begin
        aw_id_q.push_back(m_awid);
        aw_addr_q.push_back(m_awaddr);
        aw_len_q.push_back(m_awlen);
        aw_size_q.push_back(m_awsize);
        aw_burst_q.push_back(m_awburst);
      end
      if (m_wvalid && m_wready) begin
        w_data_q.push_back(m_wdata);
        w_strb_q.push_back(m_wstrb);
        w_last_q.push_back(m_wlast);
      end
      if (m_arvalid && m_arready) begin
        ar_id_q.push_back(m_arid);
        ar_addr_q.push_back(m_araddr);
        ar_len_q.push_back(m_arlen);
        ar_size_q.push_back(m_arsize);
        ar_burst_q.push_back(m_arburst);
      end
    end
  end

  // Initial setup
  initial begin
    // Initialize signals
    s_awid = 0; s_awaddr = 0; s_awlen = 0; s_awsize = 0; s_awburst = 0; s_awvalid = 0;
    s_wdata = 0; s_wstrb = 0; s_wlast = 0; s_wvalid = 0;
    s_bready = 1;
    s_arid = 0; s_araddr = 0; s_arlen = 0; s_arsize = 0; s_arburst = 0; s_arvalid = 0;
    s_rready = 1;

    m_awready = 1;
    m_wready = 1;
    m_arready = 1;
    m_bvalid = 0;
    m_bid = 0;
    m_bresp = 0;
    m_rvalid = 0;
    m_rid = 0;
    m_rdata = 0;
    m_rresp = 0;
    m_rlast = 0;

    rst_n = 0;
    repeat (4) @(posedge clk);
    @(negedge clk);
    rst_n = 1;
    repeat (2) @(posedge clk);

    // Test sequence
    run_tests();

    // Final result
    if (errors == 0) $display("RESULT: PASS");
    else $display("RESULT: FAIL");
    $finish;
  end

  // Watchdog
  initial begin
    #4_000_000;
    $display("RESULT: FAIL (watchdog: no forward progress)");
    $finish;
  end

  // Test sequence task
  task automatic run_tests();
    bit accepted;
    bit received;
    bit found;
    logic [ID_W-1:0] id, exp_id;
    logic [ADDR_W-1:0] addr, exp_addr;
    logic [7:0] len, exp_len;
    logic [2:0] size, exp_size;
    logic [1:0] burst, exp_burst;
    logic [SLV_DATA_W-1:0] data, exp_data;
    logic [SLV_DATA_W/8-1:0] strb, exp_strb;
    logic last, exp_last;
    logic [1:0] resp, exp_resp;
    int i;
    int ds_len;
    int ds_size;

    // Test 0: Basic aligned write
    $display("Test 0: Basic aligned write");
    clear_queues();
    send_aw(1, 32'h1000, 0, 3, 2'b01, 100, accepted);
    check(accepted, "A1: AW accepted");
    send_w(64'h0706050403020100, 8'hFF, 1, 100, accepted);
    check(accepted, "A1: W accepted");
    get_aw(found, id, addr, len, size, burst, 100);
    check(found, "A2: downstream AW received");
    check(id == 1, "A2: AW id");
    check(addr == 32'h1000, "B3: AW addr");
    check(len == 3, "B2: AW len");
    check(size == 1, "B1: AW size");
    check(burst == 2'b01, "B4: AW burst INCR");
    for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) begin
      get_w(found, data, strb, last, 100);
      check(found, "E1: downstream W beat received");
      case (i)
        0: begin check(data == 16'h0100, "E1: W data beat 0"); check(strb == 2'b11, "E2: W strb beat 0"); check(last == 0, "E4: W last beat 0"); end
        1: begin check(data == 16'h0302, "E1: W data beat 1"); check(strb == 2'b11, "E2: W strb beat 1"); check(last == 0, "E4: W last beat 1"); end
        2: begin check(data == 16'h0504, "E1: W data beat 2"); check(strb == 2'b11, "E2: W strb beat 2"); check(last == 0, "E4: W last beat 2"); end
        3: begin check(data == 16'h0706, "E1: W data beat 3"); check(strb == 2'b11, "E2: W strb beat 3"); check(last == 1, "E4: W last beat 3"); end
      endcase
    end
    send_b(1, 2'b00);
    recv_b(id, resp, 100, received);
    check(received, "A3: upstream B received");
    check(id == 1, "A2: B id");
    check(resp == 2'b00, "E5: B resp OKAY");
    // Check no extra downstream
    check(aw_id_q.size() == 0, "A2: no extra AW");
    check(w_data_q.size() == 0, "A2: no extra W");

    // Test 1: Basic aligned read
    $display("Test 1: Basic aligned read");
    clear_queues();
    send_ar(2, 32'h1000, 0, 3, 2'b01, 100, accepted);
    check(accepted, "A1: AR accepted");
    get_ar(found, id, addr, len, size, burst, 100);
    check(found, "A2: downstream AR received");
    check(id == 2, "A2: AR id");
    check(addr == 32'h1000, "B3: AR addr");
    check(len == 3, "B2: AR len");
    check(size == 1, "B1: AR size");
    check(burst == 2'b01, "B4: AR burst INCR");
    send_r_beat(2, 16'h0100, 2'b00, 0);
    send_r_beat(2, 16'h0302, 2'b00, 0);
    send_r_beat(2, 16'h0504, 2'b00, 0);
    send_r_beat(2, 16'h0706, 2'b00, 1);
    recv_r(id, data, resp, last, 100, received);
    check(received, "A3: upstream R received");
    check(id == 2, "D3: R id");
    check(data == 64'h0706050403020100, "D1/D2: R data");
    check(resp == 2'b00, "D5: R resp OKAY");
    check(last == 1, "D4: R last");
    // Check no extra R
    recv_r(id, data, resp, last, 10, received);
    check(!received, "A3: no extra R");

    // Test 2: Unaligned write
    $display("Test 2: Unaligned write");
    clear_queues();
    send_aw(3, 32'h1004, 1, 3, 2'b01, 100, accepted);
    check(accepted, "A1: AW accepted");
    send_w(64'h070605040B0A0908, 8'hFF, 0, 100, accepted);
    check(accepted, "A1: W beat 0 accepted");
    send_w(64'h0F0E0D0C00000000, 8'hF0, 1, 100, accepted);
    check(accepted, "A1: W beat 1 accepted");
    get_aw(found, id, addr, len, size, burst, 100);
    check(found, "A2: downstream AW received");
    check(id == 3, "A2: AW id");
    check(addr == 32'h1004, "B3: AW addr");
    check(len == 5, "B2: AW len");
    check(size == 1, "B1: AW size");
    check(burst == 2'b01, "B4: AW burst INCR");
    // Expected downstream W beats
    for (i = 0; i < 6; i++) begin
      get_w(found, data, strb, last, 100);
      check(found, "E1: downstream W beat received");
      case (i)
        0: begin check(data == 16'h0504, "E1: W data beat 0"); check(strb == 2'b11, "E2: W strb beat 0"); check(last == 0, "E4: W last beat 0"); end
        1: begin check(data == 16'h0706, "E1: W data beat 1"); check(strb == 2'b11, "E2: W strb beat 1"); check(last == 0, "E4: W last beat 1"); end
        2: begin check(data == 16'h0908, "E1: W data beat 2"); check(strb == 2'b11, "E2: W strb beat 2"); check(last == 0, "E4: W last beat 2"); end
        3: begin check(data == 16'h0B0A, "E1: W data beat 3"); check(strb == 2'b11, "E2: W strb beat 3"); check(last == 0, "E4: W last beat 3"); end
        4: begin check(data == 16'h0D0C, "E1: W data beat 4"); check(strb == 2'b11, "E2: W strb beat 4"); check(last == 0, "E4: W last beat 4"); end
        5: begin check(data == 16'h0F0E, "E1: W data beat 5"); check(strb == 2'b11, "E2: W strb beat 5"); check(last == 1, "E4: W last beat 5"); end
      endcase
    end
    send_b(3, 2'b00);
    recv_b(id, resp, 100, received);
    check(received, "A3: upstream B received");
    check(id == 3, "A2: B id");
    check(resp == 2'b00, "E5: B resp OKAY");

    // Test 3: Unaligned read
    $display("Test 3: Unaligned read");
    clear_queues();
    send_ar(4, 32'h1004, 1, 3, 2'b01, 100, accepted);
    check(accepted, "A1: AR accepted");
    get_ar(found, id, addr, len, size, burst, 100);
    check(found, "A2: downstream AR received");
    check(id == 4, "A2: AR id");
    check(addr == 32'h1004, "B3: AR addr");
    check(len == 5, "B2: AR len");
    check(size == 1, "B1: AR size");
    check(burst == 2'b01, "B4: AR burst INCR");
    send_r_beat(4, 16'h0504, 2'b00, 0);
    send_r_beat(4, 16'h0706, 2'b00, 0);
    send_r_beat(4, 16'h0908, 2'b00, 0);
    send_r_beat(4, 16'h0B0A, 2'b00, 0);
    send_r_beat(4, 16'h0D0C, 2'b00, 0);
    send_r_beat(4, 16'h0F0E, 2'b00, 1);
    // Upstream beat 0
    recv_r(id, data, resp, last, 100, received);
    check(received, "A3: upstream R beat 0 received");
    check(id == 4, "D3: R id beat 0");
    check(data == 64'h070605040B0A0908, "D1/D2: R data beat 0");
    check(resp == 2'b00, "D5: R resp beat 0");
    check(last == 0, "D4: R last beat 0");
    // Upstream beat 1
    recv_r(id, data, resp, last, 100, received);
    check(received, "A3: upstream R beat 1 received");
    check(id == 4, "D3: R id beat 1");
    // Check only lanes 4-7
    check(data[39:32] == 8'h0C, "D1/D2: R data beat 1 lane 4");
    check(data[47:40] == 8'h0D, "D1/D2: R data beat 1 lane 5");
    check(data[55:48] == 8'h0E, "D1/D2: R data beat 1 lane 6");
    check(data[63:56] == 8'h0F, "D1/D2: R data beat 1 lane 7");
    check(resp == 2'b00, "D5: R resp beat 1");
    check(last == 1, "D4: R last beat 1");

    // Test 4: Size 0
    $display("Test 4: Size 0");
    clear_queues();
    send_ar(5, 32'h1001, 0, 0, 2'b01, 100, accepted);
    check(accepted, "A1: AR accepted");
    get_ar(found, id, addr, len, size, burst, 100);
    check(found, "A2: downstream AR received");
    check(size == 0, "B1: size 0 stays 0");
    check(addr == 32'h1001, "B3: addr");
    check(len == 0, "B2: len 0");
    send_r_beat(5, 16'h0001, 2'b00, 1);
    recv_r(id, data, resp, last, 100, received);
    check(received, "A3: upstream R received");
    check(data[15:8] == 8'h01, "D2: byte at lane 1");
    check(last == 1, "D4: rlast");

    // Test 5: Size 1
    $display("Test 5: Size 1");
    clear_queues();
    send_ar(6, 32'h1002, 0, 1, 2'b01, 100, accepted);
    check(accepted, "A1: AR accepted");
    get_ar(found, id, addr, len, size, burst, 100);
    check(found, "A2: downstream AR received");
    check(size == 1, "B1: size 1 stays 1");
    check(addr == 32'h1002, "B3: addr");
    check(len == 0, "B2: len 0");
    send_r_beat(6, 16'h0302, 2'b00, 1);
    recv_r(id, data, resp, last, 100, received);
    check(received, "A3: upstream R received");
    check(data[23:16] == 8'h02, "D2: byte at lane 2");
    check(data[31:24] == 8'h03, "D2: byte at lane 3");
    check(last == 1, "D4: rlast");

    // Test 6: Size 2
    $display("Test 6: Size 2");
    clear_queues();
    send_ar(7, 32'h1000, 0, 2, 2'b01, 100, accepted);
    check(accepted, "A1: AR accepted");
    get_ar(found, id, addr, len, size, burst, 100);
    check(found, "A2: downstream AR received");
    check(size == 1, "B1: size 2 -> 1");
    check(addr == 32'h1000, "B3: addr");
    check(len == 1, "B2: len 1");
    check(burst == 2'b01, "B4: burst INCR");
    send_r_beat(7, 16'h0100, 2'b00, 0);
    send_r_beat(7, 16'h0302, 2'b00, 1);
    recv_r(id, data, resp, last, 100, received);
    check(received, "A3: upstream R received");
    check(data[31:0] == 32'h03020100, "D1/D2: R data");
    check(last == 1, "D4: rlast");

    // Test 7: FIXED len=0 accepted, converted to INCR
    $display("Test 7: FIXED len=0");
    clear_queues();
    send_aw(8, 32'h1000, 0, 3, 2'b00, 100, accepted);
    check(accepted, "C3: FIXED len=0 AW accepted");
    send_w(64'h0706050403020100, 8'hFF, 1, 100, accepted);
    check(accepted, "C3: W accepted");
    get_aw(found, id, addr, len, size, burst, 100);
    check(found, "A2: downstream AW received");
    check(burst == 2'b01, "B4: FIXED len=0 becomes INCR");
    check(len == 3, "B2: len");
    for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) begin
      get_w(found, data, strb, last, 100);
      check(found, "E1: W beat");
    end
    send_b(8, 2'b00);
    recv_b(id, resp, 100, received);
    check(received, "A3: B received");
    check(resp == 2'b00, "E5: B OKAY");

    // Test 8: WRAP refused (write)
    $display("Test 8: WRAP refused write");
    clear_queues();
    send_aw(9, 32'h1000, 3, 3, 2'b10, 100, accepted);
    check(accepted, "C1: WRAP AW accepted");
    for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) begin
      send_w(64'h0, 8'hFF, (i==3), 100, accepted);
      check(accepted, "C4: W beat absorbed");
    end
    recv_b(id, resp, 100, received);
    check(received, "C4: B received");
    check(id == 9, "C4: B id");
